links.outcome: PPV and F1 of DETERIO-LLM versus comparators including eCART on same cohort
links.effect: DETERIO-LLM achieved PPV 30.6% and F1 37.3%, outperforming eCART and all comparators, with comparable sensitivity.
links.quote: DETERIO-LLM significantly improved predictive precision over all comparators.

unlisted_practices: Selective LLM reclassification of borderline-risk predictive alerts using clinical notes to reduce false positives

screen.reason: The study tests a deployment guardrail/strategy: using an LLM to selectively re-evaluate and filter borderline-uncertainty alerts from a predictive deterioration model to reduce false positives and alert fatigue.

primary.practice: selective LLM verification for borderline alerts
